text:
tariq: Heads-up — ClipprPay (customer clipperpay-prod) reporting repeated 429s + tail latency spikes from eu-west-1a. Autoscaler appears to be toggling capacity every ~4-6m. Support escalated, customer impact ~20% errors during bursts.

oncall-bot: Autoscaler event: pool=clipperpay-prod scaled_up from 4 -> 8 at 2026-03-10T15:22:30Z; scaled_down 8 -> 4 at 2026-03-10T15:26:48Z. Recent CPU points: 37%, 11%, 39%.

maria: pulling graphs now (p95/p99, cpu, queue depth). link: https://grafana.internal/r/d/clipperpay-prod (will paste snapshots)

tariq: pasting the quick query I ran:
```
redwoodctl metrics query --pool clipperpay-prod --range 1h --metrics cpu,queue_depth,latency --output json
```

devon: pattern is clear in the trace: short bursty traffic every ~5m (burst window ~20-40s). KV cache miss rate spikes during bursts, causing per-token latency to jump and requests to pile up. Autoscaler is reacting to the immediate spike then scaling down too quickly. No obvious infra error.

kevin: customer mentions a scheduled background worker that fires every 5m with ~1k concurrent internal connections. Could be noisy neighbor in the shared pool. Support asked if we can repro.

support-ash: customer repro steps they shared: run `wrk -c 100 -t 10 -d 30s http://api.clipprpay.example/v1/generate` — they see 429s and long tails. Example request ids: r_abc123, r_def456.

maria: quick mitigation idea: bump pool min_instances to 6, and increase cooldown to 8 minutes; enable a 120s smoothing window for scale decisions. That should reduce flip-flop at expense of capacity.

devon: agree. Also want to add jitter to scale-down so not everyone scales down at exact same time. Proposal: require 3 consecutive low samples before scale-down and add scale_down_jitter=random(0-30s). I'll draft a PR.

tariq: can we try a hotfix? run: `redwoodctl pools update clipperpay-prod --min-instances=6 --cooldown-seconds=480` and watch for the next two bursts. I'll tell the customer to hold off scheduled batch for 10m while we test.

devon: applying change to eu-west-1a in staging now, rolling to prod in ~2m. Logs coming through:
```
INFO autoscaler.py: applying config update for pool clipperpay-prod: min=6 cooldown=480
INFO autoscaler.py: rolling config to eu-west-1a (staging) -- success
```

oncall-bot: Configuration change applied by devon at 2460012405.

kevin: customer confirmed: after bump, 429s dropped to <1% and scaling settled — no rapid up/down observed for 3 bursts. They reported much better latency.

maria: long-term follow-ups: (1) per-tenant burst isolation or burst-only spare headroom for noisy tenants, (2) autoscaler smoothing defaults review, (3) add an entry in runbook for "bursty background jobs causing scale churn". I'll file PROD-789 for product follow-up.

tariq: assigning follow-ups: devon -> autoscaler jitter PR, maria -> runbook + follow-up ticket, support-ash -> customer comms and closure note. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
